---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

data(rest_inspec)
```
Row
-------------------------------------

### Restaurant Grades

```{r grade_bar}
grade_data =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")) |>
  count(grade)

plot_ly(
  grade_data,
  x = ~grade,
  y = ~n,
  type = "bar"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Grade"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Records")
  )
```
### Inspection Scores

```{r score_boxplot}
score_data =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    !is.na(score)
  )

plot_ly(
  score_data,
  x = ~grade,
  y = ~score,
  type = "box"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Grade"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection Score")
  )
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Inspections by Borough

```{r borough_scatter}
borough_data =
  rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    !is.na(boro)
  ) |>
  group_by(boro) |>
  summarize(
    average_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    inspections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  borough_data,
  x = ~inspections,
  y = ~average_score,
  text = ~boro,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  hoverinfo = "text+x+y"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of Inspection Records"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Inspection Score")
  )
```
